Read the 23 lines of c1_guard.json's sweep (out/_analysis/c1_rechecks/review-pass4-visitor.md): in 22, T3-011 holds other rooms' members arriving to help this room's work (naruto t04: 'From /r/OnePiece will be glad to help!'; anaheimducks t07; epublica t12; nyjets t11; partyparrot t05; the_pack t06; uvic t02; wildhockey t04 ...). Chose to widen T3-011 rather than mint a theme: gate:27 makes T3-011 count help sent between rooms in either room's record, as gate:5 did for T3-084's requests. A new theme would keep direction but needed matching discriminators in five neighbours. 30 rechecks, 0 moved: every candidate already holds T3-011, and the sweep lines now follow the new answer. FederationPlace t07 stays T3-062 (a Star Trek moderator's sticky carries the room's call into r/startrek). 12 pairs of T3-011 confirmed; T3-005|T3-011 agrees only under the visitor rule (a watch item). Doubt: T3-011, like T3-084, no longer shows direction; the concepts do.
